signal: DecisionLink was acquired by XFactor.io, folding its customer value management into XFactor's AI-powered go-to-market platform alongside territory and demand-gen tools.

email.body1:
Doug, saw DecisionLink is now part of XFactor.io's AI-powered go-to-market platform alongside planning and demand-gen.

A broader platform usually means more in-market accounts than your team can personally touch before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for XFactor.io off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Doug, quick follow-up for XFactor.io.

With a wider product to sell, pipeline targets usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings XFactor.io needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Doug, last bit of proof for XFactor.io.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how XFactor.io's reply rate likely compares to other go-to-market software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Doug, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the DecisionLink integration settles, no problem at all. Timing matters most post-acquisition, and I know that stretch keeps a sales team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your go-to-market motion? I'll tailor it to XFactor.io either way.
